added.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
added.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
added.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
added.detail: Function `public.rpc_send_agreement_message_v2(p_expected_user_id uuid, p_agreement_id uuid, p_client_message_id text, p_body text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rpc_send_agreement_message_v2`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
